label: Bible Study
prompt: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my _____ one, and come away.
verse: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
note: The beloved calls at the window — spring has come, so come away.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it _____.
verse: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
note: Worry weighs a heart down, but a good word maketh it glad — which is the whole idea of this game.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Let us make a little _____, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verse: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
note: The Shunammite couple built Elisha a little room on the wall: a bed, table, stool, and candlestick.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They fought from heaven; the stars in their _____ fought against Sisera.
verse: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
note: From Deborah's victory song: even the stars joined the battle against Sisera, along with a flash flood.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The fear of man bringeth a _____: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verse: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
note: People-pleasing is a trap: 'the fear of man bringeth a snare' — but whoso trusts the LORD shall be safe.
